_comment: Pakistan vs. the World — the Week 18 exhibition, the league's Pro Bowl.
Each side fields ONE combined super lineup built from its managers' best
players, and both lineups are the same size — 12 a side in 2024 and 2025.
Managers contribute uneven numbers of players to it (Dante supplied 6 of
the World's 12 in 2024; Anand supplied none), and the sides need not have
the same number of MANAGERS. That is not an imbalance: the lineups are
equal, so the totals compare like for like. derive.mjs throws if the two
'standing' is the current split and carries forward to every new season, so
a normal year needs no edit here. It covers exactly the 11 GMs in the 2026
league. Only touch it if the league actually re-picks sides.
'overrides' pins a season whose split differed. 2024 is listed because Raj
was still in the league then and Ryaan and Laura were not.
First contested in 2024; there is no Week 18 before that.
